text: Run Gazebo Sim headless (server only, no GUI) with the -s flag
quote: Gazebo Sim can also be run headless, i.e. without the GUI, by using the `-s` (server only) flag.

text: Run the GUI on its own with the -g flag, connecting to a separate server instance
quote: the GUI can be run independently using the `-g` (gui only) flag. On start, the GUI will attempt to connect to a server instance.

text: Lightweight server-only package with no GUI or Qt dependencies, intended for headless and CI environments
quote: For headless and CI environments where the GUI is not needed, the `gz-sim10-server` package provides a lightweight alternative.

text: Develop custom plugins for robot, sensor, and environment control
quote: Develop custom plugins for robot, sensor, and environment control.

text: Use individual Gazebo libraries such as gz-math, sdformat, and gz-transport directly in your own C++ applications
quote: For those who use individual Gazebo libraries (like `gz-math`, `sdformat`, or `gz-transport`) directly in their own C++ applications

text: Access multiple high-performance physics engines through Gazebo Physics
quote: Access multiple high-performance physics engines through Gazebo Physics.

text: Plugin-based interface to physics engines such as ODE, Bullet, and DART
quote: A plugin based interface to physics engines, such as ODE, Bullet, and DART.

text: Qt-based GUI framework in which each GUI component is an independent plugin
quote: A framework for graphical user interfaces centered around QT. Each component in Gazebo GUI is an independent plugin

text: Create, introspect, and interact with simulations through plugin-based graphical interfaces
quote: Create, introspect and interact with your simulations through plugin-based graphical interfaces powered by Gazebo GUI.

text: Extensive command line tools for simulation introspection and control
quote: Extensive command line tools for increased simulation introspection and control.

text: Ready-made robot models (PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create, TurtleBot) and physically accurate environment models available via Gazebo Fuel
quote: Access numerous robots including PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create, and TurtleBot, and construct environments using other physically accurate models available through Gazebo Fuel

text: Copy SDF snippets of Fuel models and paste them directly into custom SDF files
quote: click on the `<>` icon in the model description page... to copy an SDF snippet into your clipboard. This snippet can be pasted directly into your custom SDF file.

text: Run simulation on remote servers and interface with it via socket-based message passing using Gazebo Transport
quote: Run simulation on remote servers and interface to Gazebo Sim through socket-based message passing using Gazebo Transport.

text: Asynchronous publish/subscribe messaging, with service calls and discovery
quote: Asynchronous message publication and subscription is provided along with service calls and discovery.

text: Integrate with ROS through ros_gz, with guidance on matching ROS and Gazebo versions
quote: This document provides guidance on using different versions of ROS in combination with different versions of Gazebo. We recommend reading it before installing ros_gz.

text: Single apt command installs the Gazebo and ros_gz versions that match your ROS installation on Linux
quote: sudo apt-get install ros-${ROS_DISTRO}-ros-gz  This command will install the Gazebo libraries recommended for your ROS installation.

text: Gazebo is available from the ROS package repository via vendor packages as of ROS 2 Jazzy
quote: As of ROS 2 Jazzy, Gazebo is available from the ROS package repository via vendor packages.

text: Gazebo versions with the same major number are binary compatible and interchangeable with a given ROS distro
quote: All Gazebo versions that have the same major number... are binary compatible and thus interchangeable with a given ROS distro.

text: Supported-versions table covering ROS and Gazebo pairings
quote: This table includes all currently supported versions of ROS and Gazebo.

text: Launch the sim server and GUI together with a sample world via a single gz sim command
quote: gz sim shapes.sdf ... This command will launch both the Sim server and Sim GUI with a world that contains six simple shapes.

text: Ships example SDF worlds that can be freely copied and modified
quote: Gazebo Sim ships with a number of example SDF worlds that you can freely copy and modify.

text: Verbose console output of error, warning, info, and debug messages via the -v 4 flag
quote: Add the `-v 4` command line argument to generate error, warning, informational, and debugging messages on the console.

text: Install all Gazebo libraries at once through the gz-jetty metapackage
quote: To install all of them, the metapackage `gz-jetty` can be installed.

text: Supports both binary and source-based installs, with documented uninstall and switching
quote: If you need to uninstall Gazebo or switch to a source-based install once you have already installed the library from binaries

text: Realistic rendering with engines like OGRE v2, including high-quality lighting, shadows, and textures
quote: it's possible to use rendering engines such as OGRE v2 for realistic rendering of environments with high-quality lighting, shadows, and textures.

text: Generate sensor data, optionally with noise, for lidar, 2D/3D cameras, depth, contact, force-torque, IMU, GPS, and more
quote: Generate sensor data, optionally with noise, from laser range finders, 2D/3D cameras, Kinect style sensors, contact sensors, force-torque, IMU, GPS, and more

text: C++ client library and command line tools for interacting with Gazebo Fuel servers
quote: A C++ client library and command line tools for interacting with Gazebo Fuel servers

text: Use a configuration script, or the command line, to specify which programs and plugins to run
quote: A configuration script can be used to specify which programs and plugins to run. Alternatively, individual programs and plugins can be run from the command line.

text: Small, fast, self-contained math library suited to robot applications
quote: A small, fast, and high performance math library. This library is a self-contained set of classes and functions suitable for robot applications.

text: Common utilities for parsing 3D mesh files, managing console output, and using PID controllers
quote: This includes parsing 3D mesh files, managing console output, and using PID controllers.

text: Use gz-sim as a library in standalone programs, with examples provided
quote: standalone               Example standalone programs that use gz-sim as a library.

text: Edit SDFormat files and interact with running simulations from outside the simulator
quote: Users: For those who primarily run Gazebo using standard tools (like gz sim), edit SDFormat files, use existing plugins, and interact with running simulations from the outside
